title: Micro Market Format Entry Thresholds and Installation Charges
content:
A market format is written for a site of a given size. Each format in the Unattended Micro Market Program carries a smallest badged headcount and a monthly sales figure it is written against, a one-off charge for fixtures, kiosk and first stocking, an installation lead time in calendar days, and a monthly charge for coolers, shelving and kiosk hardware.

| Market format | Smallest badged headcount | Monthly sales written against | Installation charge, USD | Installation lead, calendar days | Equipment lease, USD each month |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cooler & Snack Wall | 35 | 900 | 850 | 10 | 95 |
| Compact Micro Market | 90 | 2600 | 2400 | 15 | 245 |
| Standard Micro Market | 200 | 6400 | 5600 | 25 | 480 |
| Fresh Food Micro Market | 350 | 12500 | 9800 | 35 | 785 |
| Expanded Campus Micro Market | 750 | 24000 | 16500 | 55 | 1240 |
| Smart Store Micro Market | 150 | 9800 | 24500 | 30 | 1875 |

## The same figures, read the other way

A site reporting 200 badged employees and 6400 USD of monthly sales meets the figures written against the Standard Micro Market. A site reporting 150 badged employees and 9800 USD of monthly sales meets the figures written against the Smart Store Micro Market. The headcount and the sales figure are the two the format is written for; the ranking of installation charges does not follow the ranking of headcount, the Smart Store Micro Market carrying the heaviest installation charge of 24500 USD against the smallest of the larger headcounts.

The installation lead time runs from 10 calendar days on the Cooler & Snack Wall to 55 calendar days on the Expanded Campus Micro Market, and the equipment lease from 95 USD to 1875 USD each month.
